dialogue.grandline.big_guest: Whoa, mind the doorframe! We built them tall, but not THAT tall.
dialogue.grandline.famous_pirate: Y-you're the one from the wanted posters! Please, take what you need, just don't wreck the place!
dialogue.grandline.fishman_wary: ...A Fish-Man. Not many of your kind come ashore here. Well, coin is coin.
dialogue.grandline.fruit_user: You've eaten a Devil Fruit, haven't you? Stay away from the edge of the pier, friend.
dialogue.grandline.hostile: You've got some nerve showing your face here.
dialogue.grandline.law_hostile: By order of the World Government, you're under arrest!
dialogue.grandline.surrender: Alright, alright! I give up! Don't hurt me!
dialogue.grandline.option.path: I've decided which path to follow.
grandline.arrested: You were arrested by %s and thrown in a cell. Find a way out!
grandline.bloom.empty: The blossom has not borne fruit again yet.
grandline.bloom.found: A strange, swirling fruit hangs from the blossom...
grandline.bloom.none_left: The blossom is bare. Every fruit that could grow here already exists somewhere.
grandline.cuffs.resist: They're still fighting back — weaken them first!
grandline.death.final: %s the %s (level %s) has died. Their story has ended.
grandline.death.grave: Your belongings rest in a grave at %s %s %s.
grandline.faction.deserter: The Marines have branded you a deserter. You are now a pirate.
grandline.fruit.eaten: You ate the %s! Your body feels strange... and you will never swim again.
grandline.fruit.second_warning: You already carry a Devil Fruit's power. Eating another will tear your body apart. Eat again within 5 seconds if you are certain.
grandline.fruit.weakened: The sea saps your strength — your powers won't answer!
grandline.grave.name: Grave of %s
grandline.haki.locked.armament: You have not awakened Armament Haki yet.
grandline.haki.locked.conqueror: You do not have Conqueror's Haki.
grandline.haki.locked.observation: You have not awakened Observation Haki yet.
grandline.haki.unlock.armament: Your will hardens into armour: ARMAMENT HAKI awakened! (J)
grandline.haki.unlock.conqueror: Something inside you roars — CONQUEROR'S HAKI has awakened! (K)
grandline.haki.unlock.emission: You can now project your Armament beyond your body: EMISSION.
grandline.haki.unlock.future_sight: You glimpse the next moment before it happens: FUTURE SIGHT.
grandline.haki.unlock.infusion: You can now coat your strikes in Conqueror's Haki: INFUSION.
grandline.haki.unlock.internal: You can strike past armour into the body: INTERNAL DESTRUCTION.
grandline.haki.unlock.observation: You can sense the voices of living things: OBSERVATION HAKI awakened! (H)
grandline.knockdown.revived: %s pulled you back to your feet!
grandline.knockdown.robbed: %s took %s Beli from you and left you in the dirt.
grandline.knockdown.will: "NOT... YET!" Your will refuses to break and you stand back up!
grandline.knockdown.you: You're down! An ally can revive you (sneak + use). If no one does within %s seconds, your story ends.
grandline.level.up: LEVEL UP! You are now level %s (+3 stat points, press C)
grandline.logpose.blues: The Log Pose spins aimlessly. Ordinary compasses still work in the Blues.
grandline.logpose.end: The needle points nowhere... and everywhere. This may be the end of the line.
grandline.logpose.recording: The Log Pose is still recording this island's magnetism (%s s).
grandline.logpose.unset: The Log Pose hasn't recorded an island yet.
grandline.poneglyph.read_new: Ancient script covers the stone... You record it. (%s poneglyphs read)
grandline.poneglyph.read_old: You have already recorded this stone. (%s poneglyphs read)
grandline.pose.points: The needle points to %s — %s, %s blocks away.
grandline.pvp.on: PvP flag raised: other flagged players may attack you.
grandline.shipyard.soon: "The yard's full of half-built hulls right now — come back once the launch is ready."
grandline.style.race_locked: Only the %s can learn this style.
grandline.sulong.need_moon: Sulong needs the full moon in the open night sky.
grandline.tooltip.fruit_warning: Eating it costs you the sea forever. Only one fruit per body.
grandline.tooltip.ranged: Right-click (or attack in Combat Mode) to fire. Needs ammunition.
grandline.tooltip.style_scroll: Use to learn this fighting style.
grandline.train.cannot: "Come back with %s Beli and the right spirit."
grandline.vivre.faint: The card barely stirs. Its owner is far away.
grandline.vivre.made: You made a Vivre Card from your own nail clippings.
grandline.vivre.points: The card creeps toward %s (%s, %s blocks). It is %s.

screen.grandline.name: Name
rumor.grandline.1: They say the Log Pose won't settle until you've stayed on an island long enough. Patience, sailor.
rumor.grandline.2: A strange blossom grows on some islands. Pick its fruit and you'll never swim again.
rumor.grandline.3: Marines patrol every Blue. The bigger your bounty, the bigger the ships they send.
rumor.grandline.4: Beyond Reverse Mountain the sea goes mad: storms, calms and currents in the space of an hour.
rumor.grandline.5: The Calm Belt has no wind at all — only Sea Kings. Only seastone hulls cross it safely.
rumor.grandline.6: There's a restaurant ship somewhere east of here that feeds pirates and Marines alike.
rumor.grandline.7: Fish-Men have occupied an island in the East Blue. The villagers live in fear.
rumor.grandline.8: In Loguetown they still talk about an execution that started an age of pirates.
rumor.grandline.9: The stones with ancient writing can't be broken, not even by cannon fire.
rumor.grandline.10: A sky island floats above the clouds near Jaya. Getting there takes a current that shoots straight up.
rumor.grandline.11: Haki? Some say anyone can learn to sense the world. Sit still long enough and listen.
rumor.grandline.12: The Red Line circles the whole world. You can't sail through it — only over, or under.
rumor.grandline.13: Giants live far out in the New World, in a land with a tree that touches the sky.
rumor.grandline.14: The Revolutionary Army hides its headquarters on an island of white rock.
rumor.grandline.15: Seastone cuffs will stop any Devil Fruit user cold. The Marines never sail without them.
rumor.grandline.16: Don't fight in the water if you've eaten a fruit. People who do don't come back up.
rumor.grandline.17: Wano's borders are cliffs and waterfalls. Foreigners rarely get in, and fewer get out.
rumor.grandline.18: The Cipher Pol agents can walk on air and turn their bodies to steel.
rumor.grandline.19: Somewhere in the New World there's an island where the Log Pose stops making sense.
rumor.grandline.20: Whisky Peak is the friendliest town in the Grand Line... a bit too friendly, if you ask me.
rumor.grandline.21: Some swords are said to have souls. The best of them have names, and there is only one of each.
rumor.grandline.22: The Marines' headquarters sits in a crescent bay near Sabaody. Nobody attacks it twice.
rumor.grandline.23: If a pirate knocks you out, they'll usually just empty your pockets. Beasts aren't so polite.
rumor.grandline.24: A wind fruit? I heard someone ate one and made their ship fly across the waves.
